supremeCourt.name: Corte Suprema de Justicia — Sala de lo Constitucional
supremeCourt.appointmentMethod: Magistrates elected by the Legislative Assembly.
supremeCourt.fspEraChanges: During the FMLN era (2009–2018) the Constitutional Chamber was notably independent, ruling against both ARENA and FMLN governments. The decisive change came AFTER the FSP era: on 1 May 2021 President Bukele’s Assembly (Nuevas Ideas) removed the 5 Constitutional Chamber magistrates and the Attorney General, replacing them with loyalists; in Sept 2021 the new chamber authorised presidential re-election. This was done by Bukele, not by an FSP president.
supremeCourt.stillServing: The pre-2021 Constitutional Chamber was entirely removed; the Bukele-aligned magistrates installed on 1 May 2021 remain in place.
